knowledge_entries.name: music_theory_and_score_displays_in_the_music_theory_zone
knowledge_entries.text: The Music Theory Zone, located near coordinates (-0.7, -0.7), contains educational score displays and sound panels such as object_001 (score display) and object_004 (sound panel). These freestanding displays provide interactive learning about musical notation, sound concepts, and score reading, supporting visitors in understanding music theory basics.

knowledge_entries.name: musical_notation_and_score_reading_resources
knowledge_entries.text: Within the Music Theory Zone, multiple score displays and sound panels (e.g., object_007 and object_010) offer detailed explanations of musical notation and score reading techniques. These resources help visitors learn to interpret musical scores effectively in an educational setting.

knowledge_entries.name: score_reading_educational_displays
knowledge_entries.text: Score reading is taught through dedicated displays in the Music Theory Zone, including score displays like object_013 and sound panels like object_016. These exhibits are designed to clarify musical notation and support visitors in developing score reading skills.

knowledge_entries.name: rhythm_consoles_and_percussion_stations_in_the_rhythm_and_percussion_zone
knowledge_entries.text: The Rhythm and Percussion Zone, centered around (0.35, -0.35), features interactive rhythm consoles (e.g., object_002, object_008) and percussion stations (e.g., object_005, object_011). These instruments enable visitors to practice rhythm patterns actively and explore percussion techniques.

knowledge_entries.name: percussion_instruments_for_interactive_learning
knowledge_entries.text: Percussion stations such as object_005 and object_017 in the Rhythm and Percussion Zone provide hands-on experience with various percussion instruments. These setups encourage visitors to engage physically with rhythm and percussion, enhancing their practical skills.

knowledge_entries.name: interactive_learning_with_rhythm_and_percussion_instruments
knowledge_entries.text: This zone's interactive rhythm consoles and percussion stations are designed for active visitor participation. Objects like object_023 (percussion station) and object_020 (rhythm console) facilitate experiential learning, making rhythm and percussion accessible and engaging.

knowledge_entries.name: wind_instruments_in_the_instrument_demonstration_zone
knowledge_entries.text: The Instrument Demonstration Zone, located near (-0.35, 0.35), houses wind instruments such as object_003 and object_009. These freestanding displays allow visitors to experience and learn about the characteristics and playing techniques of wind instruments.

knowledge_entries.name: string_instruments_for_hands-on_demonstration
knowledge_entries.text: String instruments like object_006, object_012, and object_018 are exhibited in the Instrument Demonstration Zone. Visitors can interact with these instruments to understand their construction, sound production, and role in music.

knowledge_entries.name: instrument_demonstration_zone_overview
knowledge_entries.text: This zone is dedicated to demonstrating wind and string instruments, featuring objects such as object_015 (wind instrument) and object_024 (string instrument). It supports visitor goals of experiencing instrument play and learning about different instrument types through hands-on interaction.
